summary: Very short, very steep kerb with a house 8 m away.

best_section.where: Gordon Terrace east kerb just below the corner with the cross street

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb at 8-21 m on this side; the corner house is the closest.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sloping street, cars parked along it; no clear room off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street off a through road.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb; no signs listed.

sun_shade: Trees on the east side shade the kerb in the afternoon; open to the morning sun.
